welcome.tagline: The privacy-first CMS built in Rust
welcome.subtitle: Manage content for multiple sites. No cookies, no tracking, no compromises. Self-host for free, forever.
welcome.productPreview: A modern editor that content teams actually enjoy.
welcome.featureFastDesc: API responses under 10ms. Your content loads instantly.
welcome.featureSecureDesc: Role-based access, encrypted storage, audit logs. Sleep well.
welcome.featureMultilingualDesc: 11 languages, RTL support. Reach every audience.
welcome.featureApiDesc: API-first with interactive docs. Build any frontend.
welcome.featureMultiSiteDesc: One dashboard, unlimited sites. Perfect for agencies.
welcome.featureStorageDesc: Store media locally or in the cloud. Your choice.
welcome.featureSeoDesc: Sitemaps, meta tags, and social cards. Rank higher.

comparison.monolithic: Locked to one theme or template
comparison.headless: Use any frontend — Astro, Next.js, Hugo, or your own
comparison.plugins: Plugin roulette: security patches, compatibility issues
comparison.builtIn: Multi-site, i18n, SEO, and AI built in — not bolted on
comparison.sharedHosting: Your content on someone else's server
comparison.selfHosted: Your server, your data, your rules
comparison.fast: Rust-powered — stays fast at any scale
comparison.lead: What a traditional CMS costs you, and what Forja gives back.

useCases.soloDesc: Self-host for free. AI-assisted writing, SEO built in. No vendor lock-in.
useCases.teamsDesc: Role-based access for your team. Multi-language support and a shared media library — no enterprise pricing.
useCases.agenciesDesc: One dashboard for all client sites. Per-site roles, clone templates across projects. Scale without scaling costs.
useCases.enterpriseDesc: Self-hosted for data sovereignty. Encrypted storage, audit logs, API key management. Deploy on your infrastructure.
useCases.lead: From solo builders to compliance-bound enterprises — Forja scales to the team.

welcome.deployAnywhere: Docker, Railway, Fly.io — your infrastructure, your choice.
welcome.demoDescription: Explore the admin dashboard without signing up

differentiators.title: Why Forja is different
differentiators.privacyDesc: No cookies. No PII. No tracking pixels. Analytics built in, GDPR-compliant from day one. Not bolted on as an afterthought.
differentiators.performanceDesc: Single binary. Starts in milliseconds. Handles traffic spikes that crash Node.js CMSes. Your server bill stays small.
differentiators.multiTenantDesc: One instance, many sites. Perfect for agencies managing client sites. Each site gets isolated content, users, and settings.
differentiators.developerFirstDesc: Typed TypeScript SDK. OpenAPI docs. Webhooks. API keys with granular permissions. Integrate with anything.

welcome.featureAiDesc: AI-powered writing assistance. Generate, refine, and translate content.
welcome.featureSchedulingDesc: Schedule posts to publish at the right time. Plan ahead.
welcome.featureLegalDesc: Manage privacy policies, terms of service, and legal pages.

libraries.title: Ship faster with official libraries
libraries.clientDesc: Typed TypeScript SDK for the content API. Works in Node.js, browsers, and edge runtimes.
libraries.analyticsDesc: Privacy-first pageview tracking. No cookies, no PII. GDPR-compliant by design.
libraries.sectionsDesc: Pre-built Web Components for page sections. Framework-agnostic, zero CSS, BEM hooks.
libraries.sectionsReactDesc: React wrappers for section components. Typed props, SSR-compatible.

whatIs.heading: What is Forja?
whatIs.lead: Forja is where your website's words and pictures live. Write them once here, and your sites show them automatically — with personal data encrypted and the compliance paperwork handled for you.
whatIs.point1: Write your content once and reuse it across every site you run.
whatIs.point2: Keep your visitors' personal details encrypted and private by default.
whatIs.point3: Let the software handle the privacy and compliance paperwork for you.

hero.headline: A CMS that stays compliant by construction.
hero.subline: Forja keeps your content in one place and your visitors data encrypted — with the GDPR records, erasure and audit logs handled for you. Self-host all of it in a single Rust binary.

features.title: What Forja does today
features.lead: Every capability below is available today — nothing here is a promise.
